findings.title: Specific symbol-title RoundCorner overrides lose to generic/default values in product rendering
findings.evidence: fresh_specific_zero_dpi_component_file_artifact.puml sets artifact.title RoundCorner 0 and component.title RoundCorner 14 under componentDiagram, with skinparam roundcorner 21. Java renders artifact without rx/ry and component with rx/ry 10.9375 at dpi 150. Rust renders artifact with rx/ry 3.9063 and component with rx/ry 16.4063.
findings.interpretation: The account's precedence invariant is false in the shipped no-oracle path for explicit componentDiagram.<symbol>.title overrides.

findings.title: The claimed file Fashion consumer is not reached by valid deployment syntax
findings.evidence: fresh_specific_zero_dpi_component_file_artifact.puml contains `file "Specific File" as SpecificFile`. Java renders a file-shaped path with the specific corner radius; Rust emits a default ellipse for SpecificFile sourced from the link line.
findings.interpretation: Even though deployment.rs has a parameterized file painter, the product path does not create a file deployment entity for this valid syntax, so the claimed consumer set is incomplete at the parser/render boundary.
